#Akavir

Far to the east lies Akavir, the land of the snake-folk Tsaesci, the tiger-folk of Ka Po' Tun, the frozen Kamal and the drowned isles of Tang Mo. Twice armies came from Akavir to Tamriel. Twice they stayed.

The second time, they served the emperor who defeated them, and gave Tamriel its Blades.

#What Remains

Akaviri swords still hang in old forts, curved and folded a thousand times. Akaviri words still sit in the Blades' oaths. Akaviri blood, some say, still runs in a few old families.

Of Akavir itself we know almost nothing. Those who sail there do not write letters home.
